name: Move AI
tagline: Markerless 3D motion capture from ordinary video.
description: Markerless motion-capture technology that turns 2D video into broadcast-quality 3D animation data using computer vision, biomechanics, and physics. The Move One app captures motion from a single iPhone, while multi-camera setups serve studio production; output exports to FBX and USD for game engines and animation pipelines. Used by studios including Ubisoft, Sony, and Disney.
insight: Founded 2019 in London; raised a $10M (£8.2M) 2023 seed backed by Warner Music Group and Animoca Brands.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary computer-vision and biomechanics models extract 3D motion from video.

edge: Captures 3D motion from ordinary video — even a single iPhone — with no markers, suits, or specialist hardware.
pros: No markers, suits, or specialist hardware
cons: Capture length capped on lower tiers

references.title: Move AI's New Tool for Single-Camera Motion Capture with iPhone
